answer_1.quote: In this paper, we demonstrate that offloading content selection to a dedicated extractor, rather than relying on the decoder to perform both content selection and surface realization, can lead to better and more diverse content selection across beams, which ultimately leads to increased ROUGE scores for top-ranked summaries after applying a re-ranker.

answer_2.quote: We compare summaries to references with ROUGE 1/2/L F1  and BERTScore F1 .

answer_4.quote: To verify the ability of our approach to better capture salient information found in reference summaries, we perform a human evaluation study using the Atomic Content Unit (ACU) protocol introduced in .
answer_4.guideline: Atomic facts are extracted from reference summaries and matched with system summaries; the average number of matched units constitutes the recall-focused ACU score, and a length normalized ACU score (nACU) is also reported.
